author: Inside Edition
description: When tornado-like winds threatened his son's engagement party, one determined dad hung on to the party tent with all his strength, saving the day. After a few tense minutes, the storm passed with the tent still standing. Once the sky cleared, it was time to celebrate the happy couple and dad Glenn Alba's voice led the chorus. Alba says the storm was a perfect life lesson for married life.
title: Dad Saves The Day When Tornado-Like Winds Threaten Engagement Party

author: Inside Edition
description: Cops in Florida aren't mincing words about a DUI suspect who ran right into alligator-infested waters with his two young sons trying to evade arrest. One member of law enforcement characterized the suspect as "a moron." The suspect was eventually captured and charged with three felonies and several misdemeanors. The children were treated at a hospital and later released. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano spoke with the still-baffled police chief in Lakeland.
title: 'Moron' Suspect Runs Into Alligator-Infested Waters With Young Sons

author: Inside Edition
description: The drama continues over Washington, D.C.'s Kennedy Center. One of the most famous and well-regarded arts and culture venues in the nation has been closed as a battle continues over whether President Trump's name should be on it. Family members of late President John F. Kennedy Jr. are speaking out about the controversy. Now there's talk the venue could be demolished. Inside Edition's Justin Finch is there.
title: Will The Kennedy Center Be Demolished?

author: Inside Edition
description: Anguished parents appeared in Arizona's Maricopa County Court earlier this week following the death of their 5-year-old son. Mihail Sabo and Anca Sabo are facing charges including negligent homicide after allegedly leaving the little boy in a hot car for hours. Temperatures inside the car reached over 100 degrees. Their attorney described the tragedy as an "accident." Inside Edition's Steven Fabian tells us what happened.
title: Grieving Parents Charged In Hot Car Death Of Their 5-Year-Old

author: Inside Edition
description: It was like a scene from the wild west with a modern twist. Police on motorcycles chased a horse through the streets of Santa Fe, New Mexico, after it ran away from the start of a parade. Officials say the horse decided he wanted to take in the beautiful sites of the city, but his tour triggered a response involving not only police, but a drone and concerned citizens on horseback. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Police Chase Runaway Horse Through Streets Of Santa Fe

author: Inside Edition
description: Richard Lloyd was the guitarist for the band Television, whose 1977 release "Marquee Moon" is considered one of the greatest albums of all time. To donate to his GoFundMe, please visit: https://www.gofundme.com/f/help-richard-lloyd-fight-cancer
title: Legendary Guitarist Struggling With Cancer Treatment Bills #shorts
